elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code showing import of binom from scipy.stats, definition of parameters x=18, n=20, p=0.92, calculation of binomial probability using binom.pmf(x, n, p), and rounding result to 3 decimal places with round(). Output shown is 0.271.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to use the Python scipy.stats binom.pmf() function to calculate the binomial probability of exactly 18 successes in 20 trials with a success probability of 0.92, rounding the result to three decimal places.
